# HtmlViewEventURL <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HtmlViewEventURL:String htmlview:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `htmlview` | In | Int32 | required | The handle from [CreateHtmlView](CreateHtmlView). |

**Returns:** The address. Always an empty text here, as there are no links to click.

## Description

Gives the address of the link that the user clicked last, for a gadget made with the style 2.

## Differences

* Always an empty text, as links cannot be clicked.
